exact_statement: Fix a HI task i and define the induction over its task-local job index q in N. Base: the q=0 job satisfies the accepted protected WCRT bound under the protected HI RTA and zero-start/critical-instant assumptions. Step: for q in N, if every task-local job J_{i,k} with 0<=k<=q satisfies its bound and the release-count, interference, recurring-job domination and discrete-tick embedding assumptions hold, then J_{i,q+1} also satisfies the accepted bound. The induction is task-local and does not quantify over a global job index.
conclusion: forall q in N, RT(J_{i,q}) <= accepted_protected_WCRT_i for the fixed HI task i
source_reference: This framework theorem interface, per-HI-task inductive WCRT
